description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:330 — let pool_slice: &[Certificate] = &pool.certs; has a redundant explicit type annotation. Type inference correctly deduces &[Certificate] from the coercion of &Vec<Certificate>. The annotation adds noise without conveying additional intent. Remove the type annotation: let pool_slice = &pool.certs; (or inline the reference directly into the dfs call). Clippy would catch this as needless_type_annotation.
title: pool_slice redundant type annotation in build_path
